description.value: Big Bend Cafe is a locally owned breakfast and lunch spot that has been serving Golden since 2009, winning best breakfast in the Kootenay Rockies multiple years running. The menu spans 60 items — from eggs benedict and huevos rancheros to homemade soups — designed to fuel a day of mountain adventures. A sunny patio with views of the surrounding mountains makes it a welcoming stop for cyclists passing through Golden.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bigbendcafe.ca is reachable and confirms the Golden location address (528 9th Ave North) and phone (250-344-6111), matching the OSM tags. The site explicitly states 'Eat in dining and take out available at both of our locations,' confirming takeout. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned on the site; the OSM tags also carry none of these.
concerns: OSM name is 'Big Bend' but the business consistently uses 'Big Bend Cafe' on its website and branding.
Website carries an outdated COVID-era notice but the business otherwise appears actively open.
Website lists a second location in Revelstoke; the OSM record and this listing are for the Golden location only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating breakfast and lunch restaurant in Golden with a confirmed website and matching contact details. A natural fueling stop for touring cyclists on a mountain route.

wow_evidence: winning best breakfast in the Kootenay Rockies multiple years running
